mbfDocumentation.sourceStatement: MBF documents Neurolucida cell bodies as closed shapes, including separate cross-sections traced at multiple focal planes.
mbfDocumentation.admissionScope: Only an exact-checksum DAT contour named Cell Body with a zero-value CellBody presence property and pinned-parser somaContour classification may use this closure interpretation.
